title: Brief digest
synthetic_notice: Synthetic fixture prompt. No real client, brand or person.
body: Write a digest of the attached memo for {{audience}} in a {{tone}} tone. Use about {{length}}. Keep every figure and date exactly as written.
expected_expansion_no_override: Write a digest of the attached memo for the procurement team in a plain tone. Use about 120 words. Keep every figure and date exactly as written.
notes: T13 invokes this prompt with no overrides. Because every argument has a default, the app must not ask for anything and must not ask the user to retype the instruction.
